# uptimekuma_notification_telnyx (Resource)

Telnyx notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_telnyx" "example" {
  name         = "Telnyx Notifications"
  api_key      = "KEY0123456789ABCDEF"
  phone_number = "+15550001111"
  to_number    = "+15550002222"
  is_default   = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_telnyx" "with_messaging_profile" {
  name                 = "Telnyx with Messaging Profile"
  api_key              = "KEY0123456789ABCDEF"
  messaging_profile_id = "40017a13-3f93-4d2d-b29e-1a000000000a"
  phone_number         = "+15550001111"
  to_number            = "+15550002222"
  is_default           = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change api_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_telnyx" "write_only" {
  name = "Telnyx with a write-only secret"

  phone_number = "+15550001111"
  to_number    = "+15550002222"

  api_key_wo         = "KEY0123456789ABCDEF"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `phone_number` (String) The sender phone number in E.164 format.
- `to_number` (String) The recipient phone number in E.164 format.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The Telnyx API key used to authenticate requests. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Telnyx API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) The Telnyx messaging profile ID used to send messages.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
